description: 50 difficult, source-grounded customer-support questions fully answerable from approved Aster & Row knowledge base documents
provenance_statement: Curated strictly from active and official Aster & Row policy documents. All 50 questions are fully answerable without live system tools or unstated assumptions.

cases.query: I bought a fleece jacket marked final sale, but when it arrived the main zipper was broken and wouldn't zip at all. Can I get a replacement or refund even though it was final sale, and will I have to pay the $6.95 return shipping fee?
cases.difficulty_explanation: Requires cross-document reconciliation between final-sale restrictions (03-final-sale-and-promotions.md), defective item reporting procedures (04-damaged-or-wrong-items.md), and standard return shipping fee waiver clauses (01-returns-policy-current.md).
cases.expected_answer: Yes. While final-sale items cannot be returned for a change of mind, the final-sale restriction does not remove your right to assistance for an item that arrived damaged or defective. Under the Damaged, Defective, or Wrong Items policy, you can report the issue within 7 calendar days of delivery with your order ID, description, and photos to receive an appropriate resolution such as a replacement (subject to stock) or refund. Furthermore, the $6.95 return shipping fee is waived when Aster & Row confirms the item arrived defective.
required_factual_claims: Final-sale items arriving damaged or defective are eligible for review and assistance under the Damaged, Defective, or Wrong Items policy
Change-of-mind returns are not permitted on final-sale items
Defective arrival reports must be submitted within 7 calendar days of delivery
Available resolutions include a replacement (depending on stock) or a refund
The standard $6.95 return shipping fee is waived when Aster & Row confirms the item arrived defective
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Final sale completely removes all rights to refunds or replacements for defective items
Customer must pay the $6.95 return shipping fee for defective merchandise
Final sale items have a 30-day change-of-mind return window
conditions_exceptions_caveats: Must be reported within 7 calendar days of delivery
Fee waiver applies only when Aster & Row confirms arrival damage/defect
Replacement depends on available stock

cases.query: I am an active TrailPlus member living in the United States and want to return an unused backpack that cost $120. Do I get free return shipping because of my membership, and how long do I have to return it?
cases.difficulty_explanation: Requires synthesizing TrailPlus benefits (09-trailplus-membership.md) with current return shipping rules (01-returns-policy-current.md) to detect that the shipping benefit covers outbound standard shipping only, not return postage.
cases.expected_answer: As an active TrailPlus member whose membership was active when the order was placed, you receive an extended 45-calendar-day return window from delivery for eligible items. However, TrailPlus membership does not provide free return shipping; the shipping benefit covers only outbound standard domestic shipping. For ordinary returns, the standard $6.95 return shipping fee will still be deducted from your refund.
required_factual_claims: TrailPlus members receive a 45-calendar-day return window from delivery for eligible items
The TrailPlus membership must have been active at the time the order was placed
The TrailPlus shipping benefit covers outbound standard domestic shipping without minimum spend
TrailPlus membership does not cover return shipping
The standard $6.95 return shipping fee is deducted from the refund for TrailPlus domestic returns
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: TrailPlus members receive free return shipping on all returns
TrailPlus return window is 30 days
Return window is 60 days
conditions_exceptions_caveats: Membership must have been active when order was placed
Free shipping applies outbound only, not for return labels

cases.query: I bought a promotional bundle containing a backpack and a water bottle, but only the water bottle arrived cracked and leaking. Can I return just the cracked bottle or must I send back the whole bundle, and how quickly do I need to report it?
cases.difficulty_explanation: Tests the specific exception to the general bundle return rule: bundles must normally be returned complete, unless a component arrived damaged (03-final-sale-and-promotions.md), linking to arrival damage reporting rules (04-damaged-or-wrong-items.md).
cases.expected_answer: Under the promotional purchases policy, promotional bundles must normally be returned as a complete bundle, but an explicit exception applies when a component arrives damaged or incorrect. You do not have to return the entire bundle. You should report the damaged water bottle within 7 calendar days of delivery, providing your order ID, description, and photographs of the damage and packaging, so Aster & Row can provide a replacement or resolution without charging return fees.
required_factual_claims: Promotional bundles normally must be returned as a complete bundle for change-of-mind returns
An exception exists when a bundle component arrives damaged or incorrect, allowing individual component resolution
Arrival damage must be reported within 7 calendar days of delivery
Customer should provide order ID, description, and photographs of the damaged item and packaging
Return shipping fee is not charged when Aster & Row confirms the item arrived damaged
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Customer must return the entire bundle even when a component arrives damaged
Damaged bundle items have a 30-day reporting window
Customer must pay return postage for the damaged item
conditions_exceptions_caveats: Must report within 7 calendar days of delivery
Missing components on ordinary returns may reduce or prevent refund

cases.query: I live in Vancouver, Canada and received a travel bag that arrived with a torn seam. If I want a resolution, does Aster & Row cover Canadian return shipping in this case, and can Aster & Row send a direct exchange?
cases.difficulty_explanation: Reconciles international shipping/returns policy (06-international-shipping.md) with damaged goods policy (04-damaged-or-wrong-items.md) and exchange prohibition.
cases.expected_answer: For ordinary Canadian change-of-mind returns, Aster & Row does not provide prepaid labels and the customer is responsible for postage. However, when an item arrives damaged or incorrect, support provides an appropriate resolution without charging an ordinary return fee. Direct exchanges are never offered for Canadian orders; eligible customers receive a refund or resolution and may place a new order online.
required_factual_claims: Aster & Row does not provide prepaid return labels for ordinary Canadian change-of-mind returns
When an item arrives damaged or incorrect to Canada, Aster & Row provides an appropriate resolution without charging ordinary return postage
Direct exchanges are not offered for Canadian orders
Eligible customers may receive a resolution/refund and place a new order
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Aster & Row offers direct exchanges for Canadian orders
Customer must pay ordinary return shipping for items confirmed damaged on arrival in Canada
Prepaid return labels are provided for all Canadian change-of-mind returns
conditions_exceptions_caveats: Fee waiver applies only when arrival damage or incorrect shipment is confirmed
No direct exchanges; must reorder

cases.query: If I purchase a travel backpack on clearance clearly marked 'FINAL SALE' and a structural seam splits after 8 months of normal use, does the final sale status void the 2-year warranty?
cases.difficulty_explanation: Contrasts final sale non-returnability (03-final-sale-and-promotions.md) with explicit warranty survival clause for final-sale products (07-warranty.md).
cases.expected_answer: No, the final sale status does not void the warranty. Under Aster & Row's Limited Product Warranty policy, a product being marked final sale does not remove the limited warranty for a qualifying manufacturing defect. Aster & Row bags and backpacks are covered by a 2-year limited warranty from the purchase date covering manufacturing defects in materials or workmanship under normal use.
required_factual_claims: A product being marked final sale does not remove the limited warranty for qualifying manufacturing defects
Aster & Row bags and backpacks carry a 2-year limited warranty from purchase date
The warranty covers manufacturing defects in materials or workmanship under normal use
Warranty claims require proof of purchase and human review
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Final sale status voids all warranty coverage
Backpack warranty is 1 year
Backpack warranty is lifetime
conditions_exceptions_caveats: Must be a manufacturing defect under normal use, not accidental damage or wear
Requires proof of purchase

cases.query: Can I use an Aster & Row gift card to purchase another gift card, and if I change my mind after buying a gift card, can I return it for cash?
cases.difficulty_explanation: Combines gift card terms (10-gift-cards-and-price-adjustments.md) with general return exclusion clauses (01-returns-policy-current.md & 03-final-sale-and-promotions.md).
cases.expected_answer: No to both. Aster & Row gift cards are always final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged for cash (except where required by law). In addition, gift cards cannot be used to purchase another gift card. Aster & Row gift cards do not expire.
required_factual_claims: Gift cards cannot be used to purchase another gift card
Gift cards are always final sale and cannot be returned for change of mind
Gift cards cannot be exchanged for cash, except where required by law
Aster & Row gift cards do not expire
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Gift cards can be used to buy other gift cards
Gift cards have a 30-day return window
Gift cards expire after 1 or 2 years
conditions_exceptions_caveats: Cash exchange prohibited except where strictly required by law
Agent must not ask customer for complete gift card code in chat

cases.query: I want to clean my fabric backpack and packing cubes by throwing them in my washing machine on cold and drying them in a tumble dryer. Is this recommended by Aster & Row, and will the limited warranty cover them if they shrink or tear?
cases.difficulty_explanation: Integrates product care instructions across product lines (11-product-care.md) with warranty exclusion clauses (07-warranty.md).
cases.expected_answer: No, machine washing and tumble drying are not recommended for either item. Fabric backpacks must be spot-cleaned with mild soap and cool water, and must never be machine washed, bleached, dry-cleaned, or tumble dried (air-dry completely before storage). Packing cubes may be hand-washed in cool water with mild detergent and air-dried without high heat. If they are damaged by machine washing or tumble drying, the Limited Product Warranty will not cover the damage because damage caused by cleaning methods that conflict with the care guide is explicitly excluded.
required_factual_claims: Fabric backpacks must be spot-cleaned with mild soap and cool water, and never machine washed or tumble dried
Packing cubes may be hand-washed in cool water with mild detergent and air-dried (no high heat)
Fabric bags and packing cubes must be air-dried, not tumble dried
Damage caused by cleaning methods conflicting with the care guide is not covered under the limited warranty
Warranty excludes improper cleaning, neglect, and misuse
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Backpacks are machine washable on delicate cycle
Packing cubes can be dried in a tumble dryer
Warranty covers damage from improper cleaning
conditions_exceptions_caveats: Air drying required completely before storage
Improper cleaning voids defect coverage for resulting damage

cases.query: I am a non-member domestic customer ordering items totaling $90 before discounts. I applied a $20 promotional discount code, bringing my subtotal to $70 before tax. Did I qualify for free standard shipping, and what is the processing and contiguous US delivery timeframe?
cases.difficulty_explanation: Tests understanding of the free shipping calculation formula (after discounts and before tax) and combines processing time with transit delivery estimates (05-domestic-shipping.md).
cases.expected_answer: No, you did not qualify for free standard shipping. Standard domestic shipping is free only for orders of $75 or more calculated after discounts and before tax; because your subtotal after the $20 discount was $70, it fell below the $75 threshold. Order processing requires 1–2 business days before dispatch (excluding weekends and federal holidays), followed by an estimated 3–5 business days for delivery to the contiguous United States after dispatch.
required_factual_claims: Standard shipping is free for eligible US orders of $75 or more calculated after discounts and before tax
An order subtotal of $70 after discount does not qualify for free standard shipping
Order processing requires 1–2 business days before dispatch (excluding weekends and US federal holidays)
Delivery estimate for contiguous United States is 3–5 business days after dispatch
Delivery timeframes are estimates rather than guaranteed dates
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Free shipping threshold is calculated before discounts
Order qualified for free shipping at $70
Delivery takes 1-2 days total
conditions_exceptions_caveats: Threshold calculated strictly after discounts and before tax
Business days exclude weekends and federal holidays

cases.query: I placed an order 15 minutes ago and the order status is currently 'pending'. I realized I selected the wrong color backpack. Can customer support modify the color on my order, or can I cancel and reorder?
cases.difficulty_explanation: Requires distinguishing between post-checkout modification prohibition and pre-processing cancellation eligibility (08-order-changes-and-cancellations.md).
cases.expected_answer: Customer support cannot edit items or colors on an existing order after checkout, as product and quantity changes are not permitted. However, because your order was placed within the 30-minute cancellation window and is currently in 'pending' status, you may request a cancellation of the order and place a new order for the correct color.
required_factual_claims: Items and quantities cannot be edited or modified after checkout
Cancellation may be requested within 30 minutes of placing an order while status is pending
Customer may request cancellation and place a new order for the desired item/color
Cancellation cannot be guaranteed once order status changes past pending to processing or shipped
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Customer support can edit the color or item on an existing order
Cancellations can be made up to 24 hours after order placement
Cancellations are guaranteed at any time
conditions_exceptions_caveats: Order must be within 30 minutes and in pending status
Agent can explain policy but cannot guarantee cancellation

cases.query: I purchased a regular jacket for $150 four days ago. Today Aster & Row publicly lowered the price of the exact same size and color to $120. Am I eligible for a price adjustment, or would returning and repurchasing make more sense under your return policy?
cases.difficulty_explanation: Compares price adjustment criteria (10-gift-cards-and-price-adjustments.md) with return shipping deduction ($6.95) and processing timelines (01-returns-policy-current.md).
cases.expected_answer: You are eligible to request a price adjustment. A customer may request one price adjustment when the public price of the exact same item, color, and size drops within 7 calendar days of original purchase (provided it is not clearance, final sale, or a flash sale). Requesting a price adjustment is preferable to returning and repurchasing, because returning the item would incur a $6.95 return shipping deduction from your refund and require awaiting 5–7 business days for refund processing after inspection.
required_factual_claims: A price adjustment may be requested when the public price of the same item, color, and size drops within 7 calendar days of purchase
Only one price adjustment is permitted per purchase
Price adjustments are not available for clearance, final-sale, or limited-time flash sales
Returning the item would incur a $6.95 return shipping fee deduction from the refund
Refunds take 5-7 business days after inspection to appear on the original payment method
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Price adjustments can be requested up to 30 days after purchase
Returning the item is completely free with no deductions
Price adjustments are available for clearance items
conditions_exceptions_caveats: Must be exact same item, color, and size
Must request within 7 calendar days of original purchase
A human support specialist must approve and process the adjustment

cases.query: I tried on a pair of hiking pants indoors on my carpet to check the waist fit, but kept all tags attached and put them back in the original bag. Does trying an item on indoors make it ineligible for a return?
cases.difficulty_explanation: Tests the explicit condition-policy caveat regarding indoor fit trials vs disqualifying wear (01-returns-policy-current.md).
cases.expected_answer: No, trying an item on indoors for fit does not by itself make it ineligible for return. However, the pants must remain unused, unwashed, and in resalable condition with all original tags, accessories, and packaging included. Any visible wear, odors, stains, or alterations would cause the return to be rejected.
required_factual_claims: Trying an item indoors for fit does not by itself make it ineligible for return
Returned items must be unused, unwashed, and in resalable condition
Original tags, accessories, and packaging must be included when supplied with the item
Visible wear, odors, stains, alterations, or missing components may cause rejection
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Trying an item on indoors automatically voids return eligibility
Tags can be removed as long as the item was only tried on indoors
Items can be returned if washed after indoor trying on
conditions_exceptions_caveats: Tags, accessories, and packaging must be intact
No visible wear, odors, stains, or alterations

cases.query: I bought a travel tote using a 25% sitewide promotional code. The product page and confirmation did not mention final sale anywhere. Does receiving a promotional discount make an item final sale?
cases.difficulty_explanation: Addresses the common misconception that promotional discounts imply final sale status (03-final-sale-and-promotions.md).
cases.expected_answer: No. A discount or promotional code does not automatically make an item final sale. Under Aster & Row's policy, an item is final sale only when the product page, cart, or order confirmation clearly labels it 'FINAL SALE' (or if it is a gift card). Because your tote was not labeled final sale, it remains eligible for standard return within 30 calendar days of delivery.

Non-final-sale discounted items remain eligible for return within the standard return window

Promotional items cannot be returned under any circumstances
Discounts over 20% make items final sale
conditions_exceptions_caveats: Must not have been labeled FINAL SALE at checkout
Standard return conditions (unused, tags attached) still apply

cases.query: My order arrived 10 days ago and I just opened the shipping box today to discover that the tumbler lid arrived cracked in half. Can I still file an arrival damage claim for a free replacement under the Damaged Items policy?
cases.difficulty_explanation: Tests the strict 7-day reporting deadline and the consequences of reporting arrival transit damage after seven days (04-damaged-or-wrong-items.md).
cases.expected_answer: No. Under Aster & Row's Damaged, Defective, or Wrong Items policy, arrival damage must be reported within 7 calendar days of delivery. Reports submitted after seven days are generally not eligible for transit-damage resolutions or fee-waived returns. While qualifying manufacturing defects might be reviewed under the 1-year drinkware limited warranty, damage from transit reported after 10 days does not qualify for arrival damage replacement.

cases.query: I ordered an Aster & Row jacket 5 days ago as a standard customer, and I joined TrailPlus this morning. Does my new TrailPlus membership extend the return window for that jacket from 30 days to 45 days?
cases.difficulty_explanation: Tests the precise eligibility condition that TrailPlus membership must be active at the time of order placement, not joined after checkout (09-trailplus-membership.md).

To qualify for the 45-calendar-day return window from delivery, the TrailPlus membership must have been active when the order was placed.
